title: The role of multiprotein bridging factor 1 (MBF1c) in Funariaceae species under salt stress
author: Maria Victória Magalhães de Vargas
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be3sjgne
materials: After the salinity experiments, the samples were subjected to total RNA extraction protocol using a PureLink™ RNA Mini Kit (Invitrogen, CA, USA). Briefly, <100 mg of plant tissue was used for extraction, according to the recommendations established by the kit. The extraction product was quantitated using a Qubit™ RNA HS Assay Kit (Invitrogen, CA, USA) with Qubit Fluorometric Quantitation (Thermo Fisher Scientific, CA, USA) kit.

The replicates of each treatment were pooled for further analysis. The samples were cDNA-transformed using a High-Capacity RNA-to-cDNATM Kit (Applied Biosystems, Foster City, CA, US) and quantitated using a Qubit™ dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Invitrogen, CA, USA) by Qubit Fluorometric Quantitation (Thermo Fisher Scientific, CA, USA).

Samples were diluted with nuclease-free water (Promega) to standardize the amount of cDNA. The standard used was 20 ng of cDNA per millilitre. The qRT-PCR experiments were performed post-standardization using the GoTaq® qPCR Master Mix kit (Promega), a system consisting of a fluorescent DNA-binding dye, BRYT Green® Dye. The protocol was carried out according to the manufacturer’s instructions and run on Rotor-Gene Q (Qiagen). The PaMBF1c gene was analysed using the following primer pair: forward primer: 5'- CCGAACTTGCACAGAAGAT-3', reverse primer: 5'-GCGTCTGTTTACGAATTTACAC-3', as described by Alavilli et al. (2017). The expression was calculated by normalizing the expression values against those of the housekeeping gene, actin 2/8: forward primer: 5'- GGTAACATTGTGCTCAGTGGTGG-3',	reverse	primer:	5'- AACGACCTTAATCTTCATGCTGC-3'. The amplification protocol consisted of 2 min for GoTaq® Hot Start Polymerase Activation at 95 °C, followed by 45 cycles at 95 °C for 15 s, 60 °C for 1 min. The ΔΔCT method was used to calculate the expression levels (Livak & Schmittgen, 2001).

steps.title: Prepare plant cultures
steps.instruction: Grow two to three gametophytes of Funaria hygrometrica Hedw., Physcomitrium acutifolium Broth., and Physcomitrella patens (Hedw.) Brunch & Schimp in KNOP liquid medium under constant agitation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare KNOP liquid medium containing 250 mg/L KH2PO4, 250 mg/L MgSO4 × 7H2O, 250 mg/L KCL, 1000 mg/L Ca(NO3)2 × 7H2O, and 12.5 mg/L FeSO4 × 7H2O

steps.title: Initial plant growth
steps.instruction: Grow the plants in the medium for 7 days in a photoperiod greenhouse.

substeps.instruction: Maintain a 16 h/8 h light/dark cycle

steps.title: Apply salt stress treatment
steps.instruction: Transfer regenerated tufts to liquid KNOP medium supplemented with different concentrations of NaCl to obtain uniform stages of development across plants.

substeps.instruction: Use NaCl concentrations of 200, 400, 600, and 800 mM
Perform all plant and treatment experiments in 4 replicates
Conduct experiments for durations of 12 h and 24 h

steps.title: Sample storage
steps.instruction: Store samples at ‒80°C following the salinity experiments until RNA extraction is performed.
